prompt:
Primary request: a clean academic research figure showing the transition from ungrounded dialogue recommendation to grounded recommendation with cited user comments
Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: paper figure 1 candidate
Scene/backdrop: white conference-paper background, minimal and polished
Subject: a 3-stage pipeline with 4 dialogue turns, where an early recommendation is generic and the final recommendation explicitly cites retrieved user comments as evidence
Style/medium: high-end scientific infographic, vector-like flat design, publication quality
Composition/framing: horizontal layout, left-to-right flow, large emphasis on the final cited recommendation box, with a small inset showing the ungrounded recommendation as a contrast baseline
Lighting/mood: crisp, professional, high clarity
Color palette: black, white, muted blue, muted orange
Text (verbatim): "Ungrounded Recommendation", "Retrieve Relevant Comments", "Grounded Recommendation with Citations"
Constraints: no decorative clutter, no fake screenshots, readable labels, paper-ready composition
Avoid: flashy gradients, cartoon style, excessive icons, watermark

Primary request: an academic comparison figure with two parallel panels, one showing recommendation without cited comments and one showing recommendation grounded by explicit cited comments
Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: paper figure 1 comparison candidate
Scene/backdrop: minimal white paper figure
Subject: side-by-side comparison of baseline versus proposed method
Style/medium: publication-quality scientific diagram
Composition/framing: left panel labeled baseline with a vague recommendation and no evidence, right panel labeled our method with highlighted retrieved comments and citation markers attached to recommendation sentences
Color palette: grayscale base with blue highlights for retrieved comments and orange highlights for citations
Text (verbatim): "Baseline: no comment grounding", "Ours: grounded by cited comments"
Constraints: the right panel must appear clearly stronger and more trustworthy
Avoid: ambiguity about which panel is the proposed method, dense paragraphs, decorative backgrounds

Primary request: a concise mechanism figure for a recommendation dialogue system that grounds every recommendation in retrieved user comments
Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: paper figure 1 mechanism illustration
Scene/backdrop: clean white academic layout
Subject: user dialogue history, comment memory bank, retrieval module, recommendation generator, and citation-linked output
Style/medium: modern scientific illustration, vector-like
Composition/framing: centered architecture diagram with arrows, compact inputs at top, retrieval in middle, cited output at bottom
Color palette: black, white, slate gray, blue accent
Text (verbatim): "Dialogue Context", "User Comments", "Retrieval", "Recommendation with Citations"
Constraints: must communicate the core idea in under 3 seconds, suitable as the first figure of a top ML paper
Avoid: excessive module detail, dashboard look, unreadable tiny labels
